subject: Learning Methods
title: When Skimming Is the Right Strategy
description: Learn When Skimming Is the Right Strategy in one minute.

hook.text: A CEO reads 50 reports a week. She skims 45 and deep-reads 5. That ratio is the real productivity secret.

buildup.text: Skimming extracts the gist in minimal time: headings, first sentences, bold terms, and concluding paragraphs.

discovery.text: Skimming is ideal for triage: deciding what deserves deep reading and what can be discarded or filed for later.

twist.text: The danger is skimming everything and deep-reading nothing. Triage without follow-through produces only surface.

climax.text: Skim to decide. Then commit: either read deeply or move on entirely. The worst choice is a permanent shallow read.

punchline.text: Skim to triage. Deep-read what matters. Skip the rest.

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of skimming?
options: To triage and decide what deserves deep reading
To replace the need for deep reading entirely
